title: Patrick Stewart dies – level 1
paragraphs: Famous actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies at age 86. Many people around the world are sad today.

Stewart is famous for his big roles in Star Trek and X-Men movies. He also loves acting on stage in big theater shows. His close friends say that he is a kind man. He loves his work very much. People love listening to his deep voice and watching him act. He shows that you can do big action movies and also play in old story plays on stage.
Fans will miss him, but they can still watch his great films.
